data.text: Good, I can see the structure. Now let me run a SQL query to calculate the total freight charged on delivered orders. According to the glossary, "delivered orders" means orders with status not in ('canceled', 'unavailable').

args.purpose: Total freight charged on delivered orders (status not canceled or unavailable)
args.sql:
SELECT SUM(oi.freight_value) as total_freight
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

args.sql:
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as delivered_orders,
    SUM(oi.freight_value) as total_freight,
    SUM(oi.price) as total_revenue

JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
